h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Sonipat

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Sonipat

items.pText: In a Sonipat residential society, the resident welfare association usually decides what goes into the play area, and a decision by committee needs something clear to look at. FunPlay Systems designs and manufactures outdoor playground equipment for societies, schools and campuses in Sonipat. Our factory in Vasai East, Maharashtra, is about 1,150 km away, and we deliver by road.

Sonipat sits just north of Delhi along the Grand Trunk Road, and its townships and university campuses have grown quickly. Weather here follows Delhi, with harsh summers, a short monsoon and foggy winters. Send us the size of the space, photos and the rough number of children in the society. We will suggest equipment and send a layout drawing with the safe play area marked for your committee.

props.h2Text: How would you like to start?
props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

richText.heading: Getting an RWA to agree on a play area

c: Show residents the layout drawing along with the product photos. It answers the questions that come up at every meeting: where the equipment goes, how much space it takes and how close it sits to the towers. Mark which pieces suit toddlers and which suit older children, so parents of both can see their needs covered.
Residents on lower floors often worry about noise, so place the play area away from bedroom windows where you can. Let the committee choose colours from our more than 15 shades. A

facts.label: Delivery and installation
facts.value: By road from Vasai; installed by our team or a local dealer

items.q: Can you send drawings for our RWA meeting?
items.a: Yes. Every quote comes with a layout drawing showing each piece, the safe play area and where it sits on your site. It is easy to share with residents before a vote.

items.q: Can the committee choose the colours?
items.a: Yes. You can choose from more than 15 roto-moulded colour shades, and we confirm the final scheme with you before manufacturing starts.

items.q: Do you install playground equipment in Sonipat?
items.a: Yes. We deliver by road from Vasai and install through our own team or a dealer in north India, using the self-standing or grouting method that suits the ground.
